vapor_description: Steamworks Athletic is a team from a medium-sized town by the river, set on a small plain between the mountains. The town once had a thriving textile industry.
vapor_rivals: Steamworks Athletic's main rival is Coalvale Athletic Club. It also has a rivalry with New Steamworks Football Club, which comes from the same town.
olivera_description: Greenvale Rovers is based in a small farming village.
olivera_rivals: Greenvale Rovers' main rival is Foxwood United. The club also has a rivalry with New Steamworks Football Club.
miner_description: Coalvale Athletic Club comes from a small town on the upper reaches of the river. Once a mining settlement, the town lost much of its population when the mines closed.
miner_rivals: Coalvale Athletic Club's main rival is Steamworks Athletic.
victoria_description: Victoria Football Club is a prestigious football club based in the upper part of Terradell. Victoria is always considered a contender for the title.
victoria_rivals: Victoria's main rival is Polytechnic Institute.
nautic_description: Whiteshore Football Club is a multi-sport club based in a medium-sized town at the mouth of the river.
nautic_rivals: Whiteshore's main rival is Trawlermen Athletic. The club also has a rivalry with Twin Beacons Football Club.
dos_fars_description: Twin Beacons Football Club is based in a small village on a sheltered bay. The two lighthouses marking the ends of the bay for passing ships give the team its name.
dos_fars_rivals: Twin Beacons' main rival is Whiteshore Football Club. The club also has a rivalry with Trawlermen Athletic.
pescador_description: Trawlermen Athletic is based in a medium-sized town at the mouth of the river. The club was founded in the neighbourhood historically associated with the town's fishermen.
pescador_rivals: Trawlermen Athletic's main rival is Whiteshore Football Club. The club also has a rivalry with Twin Beacons Football Club.
nou_vapor_description: New Steamworks Football Club is a team from a medium-sized town by the river, set on a small plain between the mountains. The town once had a thriving textile industry. The club was founded following a split from Steamworks Athletic.
politecnic_description: Polytechnic Institute is the team of Terradell's prestigious institute of technology. Renowned for the excellence of its students, the Polytechnic has a large sports programme. Its football team regularly enjoys considerable success.
politecnic_rivals: Polytechnic Institute's main rival is Victoria. The club also has a rivalry with Guildhall Sporting Club.
guilla_description: Foxwood United is based in a small village surrounded by extensive woodland, an area famous for its natural springs. The timber industry also plays an important role in the local economy.
guilla_rivals: Foxwood United's main rival is Greenvale Rovers. The club also has rivalries with New Steamworks Football Club and Victoria.
